title: Twenty Years and One Straight Chair
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：dignity　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dignity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my great-uncle ① kept a dignity that no clerk in the office would have understood, and he said the keeping was the whole of the work. The ② dignity, meaning the bearing and not the rank, ran twenty years and stayed unremarked in the room; a dignity, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unpraised.

Every ③ dignity in that office had the same straight chair behind it, and the ④ dignity at the end, meaning the one he kept for the visitors and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever noticed twice. A dignity, my grandmother said, is nine parts quiet and one part somebody willing to stand; my great-uncle said the quiet is the part that fills twenty years.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dignity was the whole of the post, meaning the rank and not the bearing. The ⑥ dignity, meaning the rank and not any of that, is the only thing in a post that everybody names and nobody earns; dignity, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a bearing and a rank. He said the rank is the part they remember.

By 1956 the ⑦ dignity had become a line in a speech, and the speech had become an argument about the straight chair. The ⑧ dignity of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in August, was one office and twenty years of standing; dignity, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand. She said the standing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dignity I remember is the one at the end, which was honoured in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ dignity, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being honoured; every dignity, she said, is a rank that has agreed to look like a bearing. She said the rank was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 尊严；庄重（指办公室里守住的那一份）
B. n. 尊严（指那份气度本身，与那个高位相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a dignity 保持一份尊严
D. n. 尊严（指留给来访者用的那一份）
E. n. 尊严；体面（抽象总称，指一间办公室的庄重）
F. n. 尊严（指演说里提到、被称颂的那一份）
G. n. 高位；显职（指职位上被称呼的头衔）
H. n. 高位（抽象总称，指人人称呼却无人挣得的那个）

items.q: kept a dignity that no clerk in the office would have understood
The dignity, meaning the bearing and not the rank
the dignity was the whole of the post
the dignity had become a line in a speech
The dignity of the whole thing
A dignity, my grandmother said in 1974

answers.why: keep a dignity 意为“保持一份尊严”，1946 年伯祖父守着一份办公室里没有一位职员能理解的尊严。
dignity 意为“尊严”，指那份气度本身而不是那个高位，它守了二十年而在屋里无人称道。
dignity 意为“尊严、庄重”，指那间办公室里每一份尊严，每一份背后都是同一把挺直的椅子。
dignity 意为“尊严”，指留给来访者用的那一份，是唯一有人注意到过两次的。
dignity 意为“高位、显职”，指职位上被称呼的头衔，父亲说这个高位就是那个职位的全部。
dignity 意为“高位”，指人人称呼却无人挣得的那个而不是那份气度，是职位上人人都称呼、却无人挣得的东西。
dignity 意为“尊严”，指演说里提到、被称颂的那一份，到 1956 年这份尊严成了演说里的一行。
dignity 意为“尊严、体面”，伯祖父八月写道，整件事的庄重是一间办公室和二十年的立身。
dignity 意为“尊严”，我记得的是末尾那一份，1972 年受到敬重，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一份。
dignity 为抽象总称，祖母 1974 年说，一份尊严是唯一会因为受到敬重而变得更好的东西。
